name: Luis Salazar

items.text: The Tampa Bay Times reported in August 2026 that Salazar has been convicted of three DUIs, each more than a decade ago. Asked about it, he said he was a "different person" then.
items.why: These are old personal convictions for conduct outside any public office, with no clear bearing on real work, doing the job, or abuse of a position (criteria 4–6).

for_review: The Florida Politics article (item 1's source) and the Florida Voice piece would not load. The Tampa Bay Times page was partly paywalled, so I could read only its headline and summary. Search snippets from the Times, Florida Politics and Florida Voice mention a 2015 Brandon stop, breath readings of 0.200 and 0.210, and a guilty plea to fleeing/eluding, DUI and driving without a valid license. I did not read those details on a full page, so they are not in the text. A reviewer should confirm the 2015 case outcome in Hillsborough Clerk records and get Salazar's full statement. The one search on the owner's named sites found nothing about this candidate.
